اخرمصوا (form IVq)
# اِخْرَمَصُّوا (iḵramaṣṣū) /ix.ra.masˤ.sˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْرَمَصَّ (iḵramaṣṣa)
# اِخْرَمِصُّوا (iḵramiṣṣū) /ix.ra.misˤ.sˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْرَمَصَّ (iḵramaṣṣa)
